assets.selection_rule: within six economically fixed classes, enumerate every exchange fund listed and still trading at the cutoff, including funds delisted later; require at least 252 pre-cutoff daily rows and a total-return path fully reconstructible from the frozen raw-price and implemented-distribution sources, then select the highest cutoff ADV20 with ts_code ascending as the only tie break

class_rules.hong_kong_equity: benchmark or name identifies the broad Hang Seng Index and not a sector or technology sub-index
class_rules.united_states_equity: benchmark or name identifies Nasdaq 100 or S&P 500
class_rules.exchange_traded_money_market_cash_proxy: exchange-traded money-market ETF with at least one implemented pre-cutoff distribution whose announcement, record, ex, pay and pre-close identities are reconstructible; automatic unit accrual absent from fund_div is ineligible

assets.survivorship_rule: current survival status is forbidden; list and delist dates plus actual trading through the cutoff reconstruct cutoff eligibility
assets.fund_master_vintage_limitation: Tushare fund_basic has no historical as-of endpoint; querying L/D/I and requiring actual cutoff trading removes direct current-survivor filtering, but later name or benchmark revisions cannot be fully disproved and remain an explicit historical-evidence limitation

data_contract.volume_conversion: tushare fund_daily vol times 100 equals fund units
data_contract.amount_conversion: tushare fund_daily amount times 1000 equals RMB
daily_requirements: no rows after the physical stage cutoff
distribution_requirements: only implemented distributions with announcement, record, ex and pay dates are accepted
announcement date is no later than record date, which is no later than ex date and pay date
exact supplier duplicates collapse by ts_code, ex_date and div_cash
conflicting cash amounts on one ex date fail closed
data_contract.distribution_query_boundary: after loading only stage-bounded fund_daily, fund_div is queried only by exact suspicious ex dates implied by pre_close versus prior close and never beyond the physical stage cutoff; an unbounded per-fund history call is forbidden
data_contract.corporate_action_reconciliation: cash distributions use the frozen 0.0011 RMB pre-close identity; the official 513100.SH 2022-01-13 one-to-five unit split is applied before the 2022-01-14 resumed open and cross-checked against fund_adj; a no-factor reference-price reset may not change economic close-to-close return and any other material unexplained action fails closed
data_contract.total_return_index: previous index times (raw close times the exact official unit multiplier plus effective cash distribution) divided by previous raw close
data_contract.dividend_accounting: on ex date the distribution becomes a non-spendable receivable included in NAV for units held through the prior close; it becomes spendable cash only on pay date
data_contract.official_calendar: SSE trade_cal open sessions are a hashed stage input and exclusively define month end, next session and missing rows; the published calendar may extend at most 31 calendar days beyond the price cutoff because it contains no market outcome

candidate_registry.activation: for each risk asset, the fraction of horizons whose trailing total return is strictly greater than the cash proxy trailing total return
candidate_registry.residual: all unactivated budget is assigned to 511880.SH
candidate_registry.insufficient_history: zero risk activation and cash proxy residual

control.definition: the same frozen base budgets without trend activation, rebalanced on the identical schedule

signal_and_execution.signal_schedule: last official SSE trade_cal open session of each calendar month after close; the published calendar identifies month end without waiting for a future price row
signal_and_execution.execution: the immediate next official SSE trade_cal session open
signal_and_execution.order_sizing: at the signal close, use only then-known NAV, signal close, lot size and signal-date ADV20 to freeze requested share deltas; the next open may determine price and cash feasibility but may not change requested shares
signal_and_execution.capacity_sizing: planned shares valued at the signal close may not exceed 10% of signal-date ADV20; execution-open price gaps are reported separately and never used to increase shares
signal_and_execution.missing_signal_close: skip the entire month; never move the signal to an earlier date after observing the absence
signal_and_execution.missing_execution_open: block only that asset order, keep the old holding and do not substitute
signal_and_execution.missing_daily_close: carry the last valuation for at most one official session and forbid a signal or trade on the missing row
signal_and_execution.dividend_ex_date_treatment: create a NAV receivable before ex-date trading for prior-close units
signal_and_execution.dividend_pay_date_treatment: transfer the frozen receivable to spendable cash on pay date only
signal_and_execution.cash_shortfall_rule: pro-rata lot-rounded reduction of the already frozen buy orders; no order may increase

metrics.horizon_semantics: h sessions means total_return_index[t] divided by total_return_index[t-h], producing h return intervals from h+1 observations
metrics.phase_seed: one explicit pre-open seed observation of 1000000 RMB immediately before the first phase execution; first-day trade costs and open-to-close return are included in every metric
metrics.calendar_year_positive_rule: year-end NAV divided by the immediately preceding year-end NAV minus one is strictly positive; the first included year uses the phase seed NAV
metrics.relative_metric_rule: every relative CAGR, Sharpe and max-drawdown value is candidate minus paired static control
metrics.fill_ratio_rule: executed shares valued at the execution open divided by frozen requested shares valued at that same open; a missing-open request is valued at its frozen signal close and remains in the denominator
metrics.capacity_limited_ratio_rule: frozen requested shares rejected only by the signal-date ADV20 cap, valued at the execution open, divided by all frozen requested shares valued at the execution open; missing-open requests use their frozen signal close
metrics.nav_reconciliation_error_unit: maximum absolute daily RMB identity error

selection.winner: causal_multi_horizon_trend_budget only if every train and validation check passes
